chapter: Joining Earl Hines and the Grand Terrace
title: Tuba features: Asleep in the Deep and Tiger Rag
summary: His signature tuba solos, played even in church.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: Did you take solos back then?

Yeah, featured on me, yeah. Like that's where I first started playing "Asleep in the Deep," with Erskine Tate's orchestra at the Metropolitan Theater. I did it as a feature tuba solo, from beginning to end.
Great, beautiful, fact I played in church.
You played "Asleep in the Deep" in church, or --
I did a tuba solo in church, playing "Asleep in the Deep."
Did you have any other feature numbers that you did?
No, that's about the only, you know, name feature number I did, outside 'Tiger Rag.'
Uh-huh. You've been doing 'Tiger Rag' since then?
